question: Show orders created today.
generated_sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_date, o.status, o.total_amount FROM public.orders AS o WHERE o.order_date < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND o.order_date >= CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 100
